name: twzrd-trust-monorepo

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace=twzrd-x402-gate && npm run test --workspace=twzrd-log-verifier && npm run test:merkle-bridge && npm run test:agent-killswitch && npm run test --workspace=@wzrd_sol/eliza-plugin-source && npm run test:eliza-pack && npm run test:artifacts && npm run test:ecosystem && npm run test:guard-vectors && npm run test:mirror-sync && npm run test:house-caller && npm run test:plugin-layout && npm run test:npm-verify && npm run test:killswitch-workflows && npm run test:publish-ref-guard && npm run test:intel-receipt-doc

scripts.quickstart:demo: node --input-type=module -e 'import("./twzrd-x402-gate/dist/index.js").then(({ twzrd }) => twzrd.safeFetch("https://intel.twzrd.xyz/v1/intel/quick/35ramn32ufUApgbcgopVe5muHqNftHN1L3BfBNsDzGsx", { maxSpend: "0.0001", allowNetworks: ["solana"] })).then(r => { if (r.verdict !== "block" || r.signerInvocations !== 0) { console.error("Demo failed:", r); process.exit(1); } console.log(JSON.stringify({ verdict: r.verdict, reason: r.reason, signerInvocations: r.signerInvocations }, null, 2)); })'
